newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Jan-Feb cent/budget gap 46.3 bln forints. [Corrected 11:56 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Hungary Jan-Feb cent/budget gap 46.3 bln forints. [Corrected 11:56 gmt]

text.p: Hungary's January-February central budget deficit was 46.3 billion forints, or 23 billion forints below the forecast, the finance ministry said in a statement.
The central budget expenditure was 454.7 billion forints while income was 408.4 billion forints, the statement said.

In January-February of last year income before privatisation revenues were added was 377.3 billion (corrects from "249 billion") forints while expenditures were 320.2 billion, the ministry statement said.
